title: Pipe Mode
description: Allows the entity to configure how it should broadcast it's fluid contents to the circuit network.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Do not broadcast this pipe's/pipeline's contents.

oneOf.title: Pipe
oneOf.description: Broadcast only the volume in this pipe/storage tank.

oneOf.title: Pipeline
oneOf.description: Broadcast the volume of the entire connected pipe network for this fluid.
